name: contextcompresso
description: Local token-usage dashboard and compression proxy for Copilot and Claude Code

commands.title: ContextCompresso: Point GitHub Copilot at Proxy
ContextCompresso: Point Claude Code at Proxy
ContextCompresso: VatStash Copy Claude Code MCP Command

contextcompresso.jarPath.description: Path to contextcompresso.jar. Leave empty to use the jar bundled with this extension.

contextcompresso.port.description: Port the local proxy listens on.

contextcompresso.autoStart.description: Start the proxy automatically when VS Code opens.

contextcompresso.javaPath.description: Path to a Java 17+ executable. Leave empty to auto-detect (JAVA_HOME, then PATH).

contextcompresso.vatstash.enabled.description: Index workspace folders and provide VatStash code search (the vatstash_search tool, @vatstash, and the Claude Code MCP endpoint). The index stores a copy of your source under the extension's global storage.

contextcompresso.vatstash.excludeGlobs.description: Extra glob patterns to leave out of the VatStash index, on top of .gitignore and .vatstashignore. Example: **/generated/**

contextcompresso.vatstash.maxFileSizeKb.description: Files larger than this many kilobytes are not indexed.

contextcompresso.vatstash.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files indexed per workspace folder.

contextcompresso.vatstash.maxResults.description: Default number of snippets VatStash returns per search.

contextcompresso.vatstash.maxResultToken.description: Token budget for the snippets returned by one VatStash search.

contextcompresso.vatstash.showStatusBar.description: Show the VatStash index status in the status bar.

languageModelTools.name: vatstash_search
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search this workspace's local code index and return the most relevant snippets with file paths and line ranges.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches a local keyword (BM25) index of the current workspace's source code and returns the most relevant snippets with file path, line range, enclosing symbol and code. Use it before opening whole files to find where something is defined, implemented, configured or called. Write the query as keywords and likely identifiers (class, method, field, config-key names) rather than a full sentence; set pathPrefix to scope to a module or directory. Results are snippets, not whole files: open a file only if the snippet is insufficient.

query.description: Keywords and identifiers to search for

pathPrefix.description: Optional workspace-relative directory to restrict results to

languages.description: Optional language ids, e.g. java, typescript

chatParticipants.name: vatstash
chatParticipants.description: Ask about this workspace using the local code index

commands.name: search
commands.description: Show matching snippets without asking a model
